claims: The Mandalorian and Grogu is an upcoming live-action sci-fi film.
The Mandalorian and Grogu is directed by Jon Favreau.
The Mandalorian and Grogu is set for a May 22, 2026 theatrical release.
The Mandalorian and Grogu continues the Disney+ series.
The Mandalorian and Grogu follows Din Djarin and Grogu on a new adventure.
